title: C: Error Handling
description: Implement a function that safely divides two numbers and returns error codes for division by zero.

steps.title: Safe Division
steps.description: Write a function `int safe_divide(int a, int b, double *result)` that returns 0 on success and -1 on division by zero. Test with both valid and zero divisor.
hints: Otherwise store a/(double)b in *result and return 0.
Print 'Result: X' or 'Error: division by zero'.

verification.failureMessage: Handle both valid division and division by zero
